levels.objective: The business has an environmental policy.
The environmental policy is clearly endorsed at senior levels and has been proactively communicated to all staff.
The organisation has developed an environmental management strategy or plan, which shows how the aims and objectives included in the environmental policy will be achieved.
The environmental policy is subject to review at least once every five years to ensure it remains aligned with the latest thinking and best practice.

The organisation has delivered on its environmental policy over a period of at least five years, demonstrated by the actions within its environmental strategy or plan having been delivered and the benefits achieved.
